column2: [intro]
I’m a fan of Picasso,
His paintings, they’re not just words, you know!
He draws like no one else can,
With circles and zigzags that make a grand plan.
I love accessible art, it makes me feel so much,
Museums, exhibits—no, they’re not out of touch!
Seeing art in pajamas, my morning ritual so clear,
Art knows no age; it’s lived, not just a veneer.
When I paint, it’s a wild display,
Colors everywhere, that’s my way.
My cat, my dog, they’re my critics too,
They meow, they bark, it’s their review!
